### 2026-10-16 – # CAD Enclosure + PCB Dimensions

**2.93h**

# CAD Enclosure + PCB Dimensions

Today I worked on the CAD enclosure but also spent a while fixing up a few things on the PCB. First of all, while making the CAD, I noticed that the PCB had the wrong dimension so I went back and fixed it, also having to reroute everything. Also, I added 2 decoupling capacitors since I heard they were recommended in the type of setup I have, especially for the 5V line for the speaker amplifier.

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 191545](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KvD7dTJaHVfjYIigORhVQkYxq5FrUFSP/3b21e62fab441e841e20079e5b7d0d778aa5fd1504c7d55981b6c72762c1842a.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 200823](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KvD7dTJaHVfjYIigORhVQkYxq5FrUFSP/41019ce00d4b46c36b6d2e14fefdb22e46724c4f6bb4069eeae6ea87b4aa2fb6.png)

### 2026-10-17 – # Enclosure progress + Mounting Holes Addition

**2.27h**

# Enclosure progress + Mounting Holes Addition

Hi! Today I began by trying to import my PCB design into Onshape to design my enclosure around it. I also noticed that I was missing mounting holes on the PCB so I added those on the corners, and then exported the PCB design and imported it into Onshape.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 200244](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KvD7dTJaHVfjYIigORhVQkYxq5FrUFSP/6b4d3ee2c3edce2a25271c0bfe3dc37c59e1b374e6e0ad5df38e65098640d4d9.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 201322](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KvD7dTJaHVfjYIigORhVQkYxq5FrUFSP/4d7825fa3446bf5bdaabe26209be2d02a31359d4301bdcb0c7f2a020809385e2.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 201332](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KvD7dTJaHVfjYIigORhVQkYxq5FrUFSP/6edae1ccdf0c217825277e6aba524878e729848ea032bf8ded7806edce6bc7ed.png)

I also had to do some research into how mounting holes work and the different types of them, so I could properly add them into the design.

I then aligned the PCB with the base of my enclosure, and measured various distances to make sure they aligned with each other. I faced some problems with the parts not cooperating, but I eventually fixed it via Onshape's derived and translate tools.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 201937](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KvD7dTJaHVfjYIigORhVQkYxq5FrUFSP/07fd74b58086c7a3696acd26ac0bd54b00004dbfb231578bef73f99464c132aa.png)

The PCB looks super cool in the CAD document and I can't wait to finish up the enclosure!
